current_detail: The accepted 75 x 150 mm coordinate model contains the Hub RP2354B, exact Airband active bodies, a 24 x 11 mm ground-fenced filter tuning cell, TVP5150, an explicit AKK K331 receiver reserve and the manufacturer-dimensioned side MMCX. AKK-hosted media confirms the 331RX application circuit, all 14 K331 pin functions and the complete 24-channel selection table. A separate AKK-branded reseller-hosted dimensioned image corrects the K331 nominal board outline to 28.7 x 23.1 mm; because this is not a controlled maximum drawing and gives no height or land tolerances, the collision model uses a conservative 30 x 24 x 4 mm reserve. K331 passes the reserved Hub GPIO and 5-V power fit; a direct 50-ohm trace without U.FL reaches MMCX. Exact linear TBS5G8MMCXA is the thirteenth antenna-kit item. Airwave AWM666V RX remains a controlled but materially degraded seven-channel contingency; SP166RX and MM238R-MCU fail the physical or controlled-supply gates. JLCPCB confirmed that K331 is absent from Parts Library and Global Sourcing, found no direct replacement and accepts genuine AKK modules through Consigned Parts. The one current H1 blocker is an AKK-controlled production package with maximum XYZ, land pattern and packaging/soldering/reflow evidence; the same package unlocks the consignment application. Consigned Parts approval, final Gerber/BOM/CPL DFM and optional 5-V/channel-select/RSSI/CVBS factory function-test review are assigned to H5/H6/H7. The exact TPS7A2018PDBVR 1.8-V rail and TPS566231PRQFR / PSPMAA0605H-2R2M-ANP 3V3_MAIN cell remain accepted. Placement has zero same-face collisions across 27 intentional opposing projections and 1.44 mm minimum opposing clearance against 0.70 mm required; all 12 allowed signal groups remain bounded at 3.75-A continuous / 4.25-A step. Complete current exterior, both mirrored inner faces, external service, antenna-edge and four real section-plane views are generated from the same source and remain in progress. Regeneration exposed and corrected the H0-to-H1 Hub recovery mismatch: four compute chips now have four independent USB paths, eight recessed external RESET/BOOT controls and four keyed internal DBG10 fallbacks. Exact reused USB4105-GF-A C3020560, SKRTLAE010 C110293 and FTSH-105-01-L-DV-K-P-TR C2932107 routes were live-checked on 27 August 2026. H1 accepts the Airband filter topology/envelope/tuning strategy; H3 bounded pre-layout modelling, H6 routed extraction before order and H8 VNA select the final fitted/DNP state. Dynamic power proof remains open, while the complete physical views can be promoted to reviewed only after the K331 reserve becomes a controlled fixed body. R1 H1-H5 artifacts are historical evidence only; purchasing, PCB layout and fabrication remain unauthorized.
